businesses.business: natural gas compression equipment rental and sales

offering_description.value: Rents and sells natural gas compressor units to oil and gas producers and midstream companies. It designs, fabricates and assembles compressors, and provides maintenance and aftermarket services for customer-owned equipment.

primary_products.value: natural gas compressors; compressor parts and components

primary_services.value: compressor rental; compressor maintenance and repair; aftermarket services

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas producers, midstream and gathering companies

end_markets.value: oil and gas production; natural gas gathering and midstream; energy

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: monthly rental of natural gas compressor units; product sales: sale of custom-fabricated compressors and parts; service fees: maintenance and overhaul of customer-owned compressors
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and rents out a fleet of compressors to energy producers; OEM / manufacturer: fabricates compressors from purchased engines, compressors and components, sold to energy companies

geography_served.value: US national: Primarily Permian Basin and other major US oil and gas basins

specialization.value: related lines: compressor rentals, compressor sales and aftermarket services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and field staff selling and servicing compressors to energy operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Environmental emissions rules (EPA) and oil and gas safety standards affect compressor operations
